serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: CloudCheckr CMx Federal is a cloud management platform that makes the most complex cloud infrastructures easy to manage by delivering total visibility to your deployment. Customers depend on CloudCheckr part of Spot by Netapp to secure, manage, and govern the most sensitive environments in the world - from government agencies to highly-regulated large enterprises and MSPs - with immediate results. CloudCheckr's industry-leading solutions manage multiple cloud budgets concurrently while assisting agencies and MSPs to govern, secure, and maintain compliance of cloud resources using automation and industry best practices.
